question: Where must Brahmā and Viṣṇu be ritually laid in relation to the main installation?
premises: Brahmā is to be laid on the right side.
Viṣṇu is to be laid on the left side.
The placement is prescribed as a ritual action.
inference: The ritual requires Brahmā on the right and Viṣṇu on the left.
plain_english: One should lay Brahmā on the right side and Viṣṇu on the left side.
